title: Correct graph-snapshot source comments on restored record identity
outcome: Correct graph-snapshot source comments on restored record identity
acceptance: Source comments describe inherited restored record ids as preserved and native layer record ids as freshly minted at load, with canonical bytes compared separately.
The source comments no longer describe graph load as unshipped or a content hash as a restored record's identity.

completion.summary: The graph-snapshot comments in src/graph_snapshot.rs now describe restored record identity as the load code has it: an inherited restored record keeps its record id and its canonical bytes are checked against its typed shape separately; a native layer's record id is minted at load; a record id is a stored identity, never derived from content. The 'once load ships' and 'its hash binds' claims are gone. Comments only; the snapshot format fingerprint strips descriptions. Landed 6bca326, full gate test-f0a56ca6 9/9, round 1 clean (out-of-scope identifier naming filed as w-e50091e98190), independent evaluation passed 2/2.
